newsitem.title: USA: Barr Laboratories ships generic Coumadin.
newsitem.headline: Barr Laboratories ships generic Coumadin.

text.p: Barr Laboratories Inc said Monday that it has begun shipments of its generic equivalent of DuPont Merck's anti-coagulant Coumadin.
The company said it has received initial stocking orders of more than $10 million and has begun shipping all seven strengths of this cardiovascular treatment.

Barr, which received approval for the generic drug in March 1997, notes that Coumadin is the 11th most prescribed medicine in the U.S. and has current annual sales of about $500 million. DuPont Merck is a venture between DuPont Co and Merck & Co Inc.
